answer: Agents resist Sybil attacks with a staked identity registry: each identity posts a bond into a shared haven and must be endorsed by several already-bonded peers. Fake accounts on a shifting dune cannot earn those endorsements unless the attacker corrupts distinct honest agents, so the cost grows with every identity bought. Caught Sybils forfeit their bonds: inflating ones share of the reward garden only multiplies the loss while payout stays fixed.
